# Paths TruffleHog does not scan.
#
# Scope: test files, and this file. A negative test for a credential-handling path has to contain
# something that looks like a credential, and the case under test is that the code refuses it. Those
# literals are unverifiable by construction, and they are the only findings this exists to silence.
#
# The file excludes itself because describing that rule is how the examples got here in the first
# place, and a scan that reads its own comment reports them as findings.
#
# Read the scope precisely: it is wider than "test fixtures". `__tests__/` also matches the
# integration suites and `*.spec.ts` also matches the end-to-end suites, so a credential left in
# those is not reported. Production code is the only part of the tree still fully scanned.
#
# One pattern per line, as a regular expression matched against the path. The `__tests__` directory
# and the `test`/`spec` filename conventions are the two forms this repository uses.
^\.github/trufflehog-exclude-paths\.txt$
__tests__/
\.test\.[cm]?tsx?$
\.spec\.[cm]?tsx?$
